method: Nine authored documents read in full during pre-review; final generated statuses/metadata tables checked again by this script and mechanical assertions. Review is of disclosures and instruction portability, not a feature/build rerun.
reviewed_fields: Official trace template retains all 24 labels; actual metadata/table values checked independently against exported native files
38 pass / B9-B11 blocked consistently disclosed; no official score or full completion claim
Blank human_edits / known_issues / extra_sources / md_export_dir and team version/contact/freeze/members/source_guard remain pending; no invented no-edits/no-extra-sources declaration
Comate identifiers not fabricated; Codex own header id, parent/session_id and real sidebar rows distinguished; unavailable independent sidebar id pending
Agent/runtime model/effort/token fields reflect native exported metadata; cumulative counters not added and active cutoff boundaries explicit
Original baseline log and initial stdout gaps, failed/invalidated/helper-error/800vp rounds and cleanup rejection disclosed; failure/retry logs retained
Sources are historically observed local baseline reuse, original local text and prior official SDK research; no new network access or SDK integration claim
Build instructions use PATH and packaged relative Python entry points, state unsigned-HAP/signing limitations and actual target/observed SDK differences, and do not rely on private absolute paths
JSON is a single cml-spec7 task with not_completed draft default and package-relative project directory/build file/trace file mapping; no final submission/ZIP claim
Draft derivatives/caches/temporary clones excluded; snapshot version differs from base HEAD and formal team freeze; post-cutoff events left to Stage 3
Privacy disclosure retains local usernames/paths in raw unredacted task-only native copies; bounded artifact scan does not replace pending final human sensitivity review
